channels.tagline: An independent Irish studio building a browser creature adventure with imagination, responsible AI and real space discovery.
channels.about:
Mythical Void began at home with a father, his nine-year-old son and a question: what could generative AI tools and a lot of imagination make possible?

Those conversations grew into strange creatures, living realms and a free browser adventure. Players hatch a creature, restore worlds affected by the Void and make choices about Project Beacon. Optional NASA-powered discoveries connect the fictional journey to real space.

We are building the studio in the same spirit: small, independent, ambitious and AI-first, while people remain responsible for the story, safety, evidence and important decisions.

Play now: https://mythicalvoid.com/
Press room: https://mythicalvoid.com/press/

firstPosts.copy:
Mythical Void began at home with a father, his nine-year-old son and a question: what could generative AI tools and a lot of imagination make possible?

The answer became strange creatures, living worlds and a browser game you can play today. Imagination still leads. AI helps a very small team explore and build. People remain responsible for the story, safety and important choices.

Play Mythical Void: https://mythicalvoid.com/

firstPosts.copy:
We are trying to build an AI-first game studio without making responsibility disappear.

At Mythical Void, AI can help us imagine, test, organise and create. It cannot make a safety decision, invent evidence, quietly publish as the studio or replace human judgement where children and families are involved.

That boundary is part of the product, not paperwork added afterwards. Read our story and play: https://mythicalvoid.com/
firstPosts.disclosure: The reviewed card uses brand artwork created with generative AI and refined for Mythical Void; it is not a generated studio photograph.

firstPosts.copy:
A fantasy game can still open a door to real science.

Mythical Void can use selected NASA public space data for optional discovery moments. We have also made a free four-page STEM Creature Lab for ages 9-14, families, clubs and classrooms.

Get the activity: https://mythicalvoid.com/nasa-space-science/
Play the game: https://mythicalvoid.com/

Independent Mythical Void activity. NASA does not endorse Mythical Void.

kevinActivationChecklist: Create the YouTube business-name channel using the Mythical Void display name.
Choose the first available handle from the prepared list; do not assume any handle is reserved.
Select 'review this setting for every video' for the YouTube audience setting.
Keep YouTube comments off until a named adult has a reliable review time; then use hold all.
